description: This file defines the Cart class in the OpenCart project, specifically within the checkout module. The class provides methods to retrieve products from the cart and calculate total amounts, integrating with extensions and other parts of the system.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents a shopping cart in the checkout system, providing methods to retrieve products and calculate totals.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products from the shopping cart with detailed information, including image, options, and subscription details.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates the total amount, taxes, and other relevant totals for the current cart, utilizing extensions.
